name: bmi_bsa
description: Body-mass index with the WHO adult categories (and a percentile note under 18) and body-surface area by the Mosteller, DuBois, Haycock and Gehan-George formulas, from metric or imperial weight and height. BMI is an exact fraction; every output carries a disclaimer: not medical advice, verify with a clinician.

age.description: Years; under 18 the adult categories are withheld

catalog.source: WHO adult BMI classification (BMI 18.5, 25, 30, 35, 40 cut-offs); Mosteller, N Engl J Med 1987;317:1098; DuBois & DuBois, Arch Intern Med 1916;17:863; Haycock et al., J Pediatr 1978;93:62; Gehan & George, Cancer Chemother Rep 1970;54:225
